# Frozen publication boundary for the tree-history scan (check_private_infra.py --tree-rev).
#
# Every commit that was already published on GitHub at the 2026-10-05 cutoff, by full SHA,
# one per line: the complete ancestry of the 88 refs the repository advertised then
# (55 branches, 33 refs/pull/N/head, tag v0.3.0), excluding refs/heads/claude/metadata-guard.
#
# The history was rewritten on 2026-10-09, with owner approval, to remove personal data
# from commit metadata and from text blobs. Every SHA changed. The 274 entries were
# remapped one for one through the rewrite's old-to-new commit map, so the set covers the
# same commits under their new names. No commit was added and none was dropped.
#
# Meaning: the trees of these commits are already public and are not rescanned when they
# appear in a pushed commit's history. That is not approval of anything in them. Every
# commit NOT listed here is new and its whole tree must be clean, including content it
# reuses from these old commits; every pushed tip's tree is scanned even when the tip
# itself is listed. The boundary is never extended from remote refs. The file is pinned by
# PUBLICATION_BOUNDARY_SHA256 in check_private_infra.py.
